items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The one above that is Linda McCartney at a Hammond B3 organ

ctx.x: I was in Wings from ’78 to ’81. And the picture next to that is Paul McCartney with a concertina sitting on the balcony of a castle, a twelfth century castle on the south coast of England when we were recording. The one above that is Linda McCartney at a Hammond B3 organ, and you can’t really see clearly but on top of the organ there is a pack of Senior Service, Players Senior Service cigarettes, no filtertips, which is what Paul smoked at the time. There’s a cup of tea, a scotch and Coke, a bunch of boxes of…
Well I have a burning question here, do your grandchildren get to play with your guitars?
